verdict: Organic search is your only active engine, and it's slowing.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity came entirely from organic local search — no paid ads ran on Meta or Google. Your Google Business profiles combined for 178 actions (directions, calls, and website clicks), but engagement dropped 9% week-over-week, and the most recent three days showed a sharp pullback from prior levels. One of your three profiles generated 376 impressions over the period without a single tracked call, pointing to a missed opportunity to capture interested prospects. We're reviewing that profile's call setup now and assessing whether paid search should be restarted to provide a more reliable lead flow alongside organic.
